custom_questions.description: the residual tenant form answers, including the form's own approval/authorisation answers

date_of_request.description: the date the requester raised the request

date_required.description: the date the requested items are needed on site

delivery_address.description: where the requested items are to be delivered

external_id.description: Assignar form-result id; substrate source identity and idempotency key

financial_period.description: the accounting period the request falls in; a declared coordinate, not present in the source payload

form_id.description: which Assignar requisition form template produced the row — provenance for a title-pattern match that can sweep renamed forms

occurred_at.description: submission time of the requisition — the episodic event time

project.description: the project the request serves, when the form captured it

project_task.description: the project task/activity the request is for

requested_items.description: the plant/equipment and staff the requisition asks for, as an itemised list rather than one top-level key per named person or machine

site_address.description: the site address, where distinct from the delivery address

source_modified_at.description: last modification at source; the form_pattern delta cursor

worker.description: the worker the requisition is attributed to
